description: This Java source file contains test step definitions for global configuration management within the Fineract project, utilizing Cucumber for BDD testing, and interacts with various APIs and helpers to verify configuration behaviors.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationStepDef
classes.description: A class defining Cucumber step definitions for managing global configurations in tests, including enabling/disabling configs and updating currency values, with assertions for expected error responses.

methods.name: disableGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Disables a specified global configuration key.

methods.name: enableGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Enables a specified global configuration key.

methods.name: setGlobalConfigValueString
methods.description: Sets a global configuration value as a string.

methods.name: setGlobalConfigValueStringDefaultApi
methods.description: Sets a global configuration value via the DefaultApi using a string converted to Long.

methods.name: updateCurrencyEmptyValueFailure
methods.description: Attempts to update currency with an empty list, expecting an error response and validating it.

methods.name: updateCurrencyNullValueFailure
methods.description: Attempts to update currency with a null value, expecting an error response and validating it.

methods.name: updateCurrencyIncorrectValueFailure
methods.description: Attempts to update currency with an incorrect value, expecting an error response and validating it.
